title: The Anvil Cloud Canon
summary: A canon of towering flat-topped storm qi that is raised overhead and dropped on the foe for students past the middle courses.

title: A Treatise on Cutting Shear
summary: A treatise on layers of storm qi that run at different speeds and shear whatever is caught between them.

title: The Eyewall Course
summary: A course in a living field of storm qi with a violent ring and a calm centre where the user and allies stand.

title: The Twin Cloud Treatise
summary: A treatise on raising two clouds of storm qi side by side so that one guards while the other strikes.

title: Manual of the Hawk's Thunder Stoop
summary: A manual of diving strikes loosed from above in the manner of a hawk with thunder gathered in its wings.

title: The Paired Tempest Compendium
summary: A compendium of two storm fields run side by side over the basin and the river so each feeds the other.

title: The Wind-Sworn Storm Reckoning
summary: A reckoning of storm moves by which a wind-sworn student carries the storm on the plateau and answers it.

title: Treatise on Bearing and Thunder
summary: A treatise on taking a bearing by the thunder and loosing a bolt that follows the bearing home.

title: The Oath of the Unwalled Storm
summary: A manual of the sworn storm that keeps no wall and fills the whole field with weather the oath commands.
